affordance_in_statement: A deadlock is defined solely by which worker pairs occur: "The primary and secondary files must share exactly one worker in common" and "The closing file must consist exactly of these two unique workers." The records are presented as a collection, with no significance assigned to their input order.
removal_suggestion: Make the record order part of validity while preserving the same input and output formats: require a valid deadlock for sorted workers a < b < c to consist of three consecutive input records exactly in the order (a,b), (a,c), (b,c). Keep the existence guarantee, but ensure it applies to this stronger condition.
